question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**running up**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context involves villagers responding urgently to the boy's cry for help.
 
• The boy is on a hill, so villagers must move upward to reach him.
 
• The phrase "**running up**" indicates both the urgency and the direction of motion needed to reach the boy.
